mcp.description: Submit an access-gated AlphaFold 3 scientific run.

input_mode.description: raw runs the CPU data pipeline; enriched consumes a verified processed-JSON artifact and skips preprocessing.

raw_input_sha256.description: Required for enriched input; the original raw-input digest bound by the relocatable handoff.

limitations: A source revision observation is not workload, hardware, semantic, or license qualification.
Candidate contract only: no BatchRun controller, Kueue Job, route, or credential is generated.
Reference databases require at least one TiB of shared ReadWriteMany storage; GPU-node ephemeral disk is not used.

The official-loader-v2 H100 run passed after correcting private-volume permissions (405 arrays, 368384602 elements, 41.42-second minimal inference, five CIFs), but the tested bead2e image reports a development identity; rebuild to a final digest and repeat the semantic gate before route qualification.
The user-authorized academic PoC may stage and execute the exact parameter asset only in restricted quarantine; formal institutional acceptance remains required for production promotion.

mcp.description: Submit a bounded asynchronous BoltzGen design campaign.

limitations: Candidate adapter only; an immutable locally smoke-tested image exists, but artifact readiness, H100 semantic receipt, route, and live readiness do not.
A preempted attempt restarts from committed inputs; BoltzGen partial attempt output is not represented as a resumable platform checkpoint.
The separately pinned inference molecule dictionary remains blocked on its terms receipt.

mcp.description: Submit a typed ESMFold2 structure-prediction run.

limitations: A source revision observation is not workload, hardware, semantic, or license qualification.
Candidate contract only: no BatchRun controller, Kueue Job, route, or credential is generated.
The source and exact offline files are qualified inputs, but the required offline wrapper is not yet packaged in a digest-pinned image and no semantic or H100 receipt exists.

mcp.description: Submit a protein-only single-sequence ESMFold2-Fast run.

limitations: A source revision observation is not workload, hardware, semantic, or license qualification.
Candidate contract only: no BatchRun controller, Kueue Job, route, or credential is generated.
Fast is protein-only and single-sequence; it does not accept MSA, ligand, nucleic-acid, modified-residue, or CCD inputs.
The required offline single-sequence wrapper is not yet packaged in a digest-pinned image; no semantic or H100 qualification exists.

mcp.description: Submit an OpenFold3 OpenBind-0 scientific run.

limitations: A source revision observation is not workload, hardware, semantic, or license qualification.
Candidate contract only: no BatchRun controller, Kueue Job, route, or credential is generated.
Covalent bonds and glycans must be rejected, not dropped or translated.
Reference databases require at least one TiB of shared ReadWriteMany storage.
The baked offline runner template and executable wrapper remain H100-unqualified until the corrected image passes semantic smoke; precomputed MSA is not admitted.
This upstream OpenBind-0 candidate is an explicit variant of canonical model ID openfold3; it does not replace the retained NIM record.

mcp.description: Submit a bounded asynchronous Proteina-Complexa binder design run.

limitations: Candidate adapter only; an immutable locally smoke-tested image exists, but artifact readiness, H100 semantic receipt, route, and live readiness do not.
Core self-refolding uses a controller-mounted AlphaFold2 or RoseTTAFold3 artifact; optional ESM2, ESMFold, and MPNN metrics are disabled until their exact artifacts pass readiness.

mcp.description: Submit a typed Protenix v2 prediction after artifact admission.

limitations: A source revision observation is not workload, hardware, semantic, or license qualification.
CPU preparation must complete and commit its enriched JSON before GPU admission.
Candidate contract only: no BatchRun controller, Kueue Job, route, or credential is generated.
Checkpoint is verified against a third-party mirror, not publisher bytes; route remains unqualified until H100 evidence.
The lane remains fail-closed until the corrected image, all four common assets, and real H100 semantics are verified.
